films.title: All the Invisible Children
films.overview: Seven short films - each one focused on the plight of a different child protagonist.

films.title: Cracks
films.overview: Jealousy flares after the headmistress of an elite boarding school for girls becomes obsessed with a new student.

films.title: A Sacrifice
films.overview: American social psychologist Ben Monroe investigates a local cult connected to a disturbing event. While he immerses himself into his work, his rebellious teenage daughter, Mazzy, gets involved with a mysterious local boy, who introduces her to the city’s underground party scene. As these two worlds head towards an intersection, Mazzy finds herself in great danger and Ben will need to race against the clock to save her.
